findings.description: Regex pattern with nested quantifiers that could potentially cause ReDoS with specially crafted input
findings.reasoning: This pattern has nested quantifiers ([^{}]* followed by (?:...)*) which can cause catastrophic backtracking on input that doesn't match. However, the pattern is only used to parse route definitions provided by developers (via add_route/add_get/add_post etc.), not user-supplied input. The input is trusted developer code, not untrusted user data, which significantly reduces the practical risk.
